bosses.name: Roogug
bosses.general: Quilboar geomancer: Lightning Bolt and an earth totem.
bosses.dps: Kill his totem, interrupt his bolts.

bosses.name: Aggem Thorncurse
bosses.general: Heals himself and calls a boar spirit.
bosses.dps: Interrupt his heals, kill the boar, then him.

bosses.name: Death Speaker Jargba
bosses.general: Mind controls one of us and casts Shadow Bolt.
bosses.tank: Keep him on you; don't hit the controlled friend hard.
bosses.healer: Dispel the mind control if you can.
bosses.dps: Burn him, the control ends when he dies.

bosses.name: Overlord Ramtusk
bosses.general: Quilboar chief with guards and a Battle Shout.
bosses.tank: Pull him with his guards and hold them all.

bosses.name: Agathelos the Raging
bosses.general: Huge boar: Rampage knocks everyone near away, and he enrages.
bosses.tank: Back to a wall, face him away.
bosses.healer: Stay at range, heal through the enrage.
bosses.dps: Ranged at range; melee from behind.

bosses.name: Charlga Razorflank
bosses.general: The last boss: Chain Bolt, Renew and Purity heal her, she comes with two guards.
bosses.tank: Hold her and the guards; pull her round a corner.
bosses.dps: Interrupt her heals; guards first, or crowd control them.

bosses.name: Earthcaller Halmgar
bosses.general: Rare quilboar shaman with an earth elemental.
